name: unfold-deploy
description: Watch what happens after you hit Enter: a live, explained flow of your Vercel deploys in the terminal.
author: faizm10

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-ui.mjs
scripts.demo:success: npm run build && node bin/unfold.js demo success
scripts.demo:failure: npm run build && node bin/unfold.js demo build-failure
scripts.demo:interrupted: npm run build && node bin/unfold.js demo interrupted
